parsed.notes: The filing states only that People Inc. (the borrower subsidiary) must maintain certain consolidated net leverage ratios each quarter and was in compliance at both dates. It discloses neither the actual ratio nor the covenant limit. The direction is inferred as a maximum from the wording 'if ... ratios are exceeded'. Net leverage-based pricing of the commitment fee and interest margin, the excess cash flow sweep and the 2032 Notes indenture were excluded. The Company may contribute cash to People Inc. to improve the ratio.
